Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

DepositFeeUpdated(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when deposit fee is updated

IssueFeeUpdated(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when issue fee is updated

LiquidatorIncentiveUpdated(uint256,uint2.notice: Emitted when liquidator incentive is updated

ProtocolLiquidationFeeUpdated(uint256,ui.notice: Emitted when protocol liquidation fee is updated

RepayFeeUpdated(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when repay fee is updated

SwapFeeUpdated(address,address,uint256,u.notice: Emitted when swap fee is updated

WithdrawFeeUpdated(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when withdraw fee is updated

depositFee().notice: The fee charged when depositing collateral

issueFee().notice: The fee charged when minting a synthetic token

liquidationFees().notice: The fees charged when liquidating a position

repayFee().notice: The fee charged when repaying debt

swapFees(address,address).notice: The fees charged when swapping synthetic tokens (by synthIn => synthOut directions)

withdrawFee().notice: The fee charged when withdrawing collateral
